description: EVM DeFi agent for SVP-Chain. It synchronizes its private DeFi MCP tool catalog at startup and can plan read-only DeFi tasks with an LLM. Every state-changing EVM payload is signed by the caller locally before broadcast.
name: svpchain-evm-agent

skills.description: Wallet-signature authentication: auth_challenge issues a challenge bound to an owner address, auth_verify checks the wallet's signature and mints a bearer token that authenticates subsequent calls (Authorization header, envelope field, or bound to this A2A context). Tools: auth_challenge, auth_verify.
skills.name: SVP-Chain Self-Service Auth

skills.description: Discovery: list_tools returns every tool this agent serves, with the skill it belongs to and the JSON Schema of its arguments — the A2A equivalent of MCP's tools/list, which the A2A protocol itself does not provide. Needs no credential. Tools: list_tools.
skills.name: SVP-Chain Agent Self-Description

skills.description: EVM transaction broadcast and status. Additional private MCP tools are synchronized at startup and published here only when the private service is reachable. Tools: broadcast_evm_tx, evm_tx_status.
skills.name: SVP-Chain EVM
